dog.description_text:
Calla’s world changed when her owner could no longer care for her, but this sweet New York girl hasn’t let that dim her light. With her gentle heart and playful spirit, Calla is the kind of pup who makes every house feel like home. She loves toys, belly rubs, and being close to her people; whether that’s cuddling on the couch or following you from room to room just to keep you company.

Calla has a soft, loving nature and an easygoing charm that makes everyone fall for her. She’s ready for a fresh start with a family who will cherish her as much as she’ll adore them. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend with a playful spark, Calla is waiting to meet you.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
